headline: Chinese Stocks Extend Losses as AI Competition Pressures Valuations
summary: Trillions of dollars have been wiped from Chinese stock markets amid a high-stakes artificial intelligence race with the United States. Despite state-backed funds attempting to stem the rout, investors remain uncertain about the market's trajectory.
why: Beijing's technology sector policies and intense US-China tech competition heavily influence global risk sentiment. State interventions via national investment funds are frequently deployed to stabilize domestic equity indices during sell-offs.

impacts.name: Chinese Equities
impacts.why: Persistent valuation pressures in the technology sector and doubts over state intervention drove broad market declines.

why_moved: Massive capital destruction in major tech indices and questionable efficacy of state-backed buying trigger broader risk-off sentiment across emerging and global equities.
